sources.title: SCDNR Rules & Regulations digest — finfish size & catch limits
SCDNR freshwater fish size & possession limits

species.limit: 10 shad per person per day except in Santee River and Rediversion Canal (20 per person per day)
species.quote: American Shad | See Shad & Herring Fishing Regulations. | 10 shad per person per day except in Santee River and Rediversion Canal (20 per person per day)
species.notes: See Shad & Herring Fishing Regulations for licensing, permitting, and gear requirements.

species.limit: 5 per person per day
species.quote: Black Drum | | 5 per person per day | 14-inch to 27-inch TL

species.limit: 5 per person per day (7 per person in the for-hire fishery)
species.quote: Bluefish | | 5 per person per day (7 per person in the for-hire fishery)

species.limit: 5 per person per day not to exceed 10 per boat per day
species.quote: Flounders (Southern, Summer & Gulf) | | 5 per person per day not to exceed 10 per boat per day | 16-inch TL | Bag limit applies to hook and line or gig.

species.season: May not be harvested by gig Dec. 1 - Feb. 28
species.limit: 1 per person per day (state waters) not to exceed 2 per boat per day
species.quote: Red Drum | May not be harvested by gig Dec. 1 - Feb. 28 | 1 per person per day (state waters) not to exceed 2 per boat per day Possession prohibited in federal waters. | 18-inch to 25-inch TL | May only be taken by rod & reel and gig. — Effective July 1, 2026 (Act No. 231).
species.notes: Rod & reel and gig only; no gigging Dec 1 – Feb 28. Possession prohibited in federal waters.

species.limit: Possession prohibited
species.quote: Possession prohibited in federal waters. May not be harvested from federal waters.

species.limit: Possession prohibited
species.quote: Saltwater Catfishes (Hardhead & gafftopsail catfishes) | Possession prohibited | Possession prohibited | | If caught must be released immediately.

species.limit: 10 per person per day not to exceed 30 per boat per day
species.quote: Sheepshead | | 10 per person per day not to exceed 30 per boat per day | 14-inch TL

species.season: May not be harvested by gig Dec. 1 - Feb. 28
species.limit: 10 per person per day
species.quote: Spotted Seatrout | May not be harvested by gig Dec. 1 - Feb. 28 | 10 per person per day | 14-inch TL | May only be taken by rod & reel and gig.

species.season: Possession prohibited: June 16 - Sept. 30; open Oct. 1 - June 15
species.limit: 3 fish per person per day: Oct. 1 - June 15
species.quote: Striped Bass | Possession prohibited: June 16 - Sept. 30 … | Possession prohibited: June 16 - Sept. 30; 3 fish per person per day: Oct. 1 - June 15 except in lower reach of the Savannah River (2 per person per day year round) | 26 inch TL except in lower reach of the Savannah River (27 inch TL) | May only be taken by rod & reel.

species.limit: 2 per person per day year round
species.quote: except in lower reach of the Savannah River (2 per person per day year round; 27 inch TL)

species.limit: 1 per person per day
species.quote: Tarpon | | 1 per person per day | 77-inch FL | May only be taken by rod & reel.

species.limit: 3 per person per day not to exceed 9 per boat per day
species.quote: Tripletail | | 3 per person per day not to exceed 9 per boat per day | 18-inch TL

species.limit: 1 per person per day
species.quote: Weakfish | | 1 per person per day | 12-inch TL

species.zone: State waters south of Jeremy Inlet (Edisto)
species.limit: 1 per person per day and no more than 3 per boat per day

species.zone: State waters north of Jeremy Inlet and federal waters
species.limit: 1 per person per day and no more than 6 per boat per day
species.quote: 1 per person per day and no more than 6 per boat per day federal waters and state waters north of 032° 31.0’ N | 36-inch FL

species.limit: 10 per person per day not to exceed 54 per boat per day. Headboats have no boat limit

species.limit: 2 per person per day
